name: Riley
label: Bug-weary user rolling back versions
who: I use Spotify on Android and on a PC, and I have hit bugs after updates, such as downloads failing offline and slow scrolling through large liked-song lists. I have tried rolling back to older app versions and reinstalling to get things working again.
value_for_money: Mostly unclear. Some say they cancelled because a bug went unresolved for months, and one says support spent hours on the problem without a fix. The posts judge the service mainly by whether the app works.
loyalty: Their playlists and library survive reinstalls, and they return when a workaround or fix works. Persistent bugs with no fix from support are what push them to cancel or consider leaving.
pain_points: Slow scrolling through large liked-song lists
Auto-updates bringing back the broken version
reasons_to_stay: Their playlists and library survive reinstalls, and several say the app works again after a workaround, so they keep using it rather than leaving. Their frustration is with specific bugs, not with the service's core library.
tone: Practical and troubleshooting-focused, listing steps and workarounds with occasional exasperation.
